content:
I have been close to the mountains and hiking since childhood, when my parents would take me on hikes during the holidays. Later, I discovered the magic of trekking and bivouacking. In 2022, I settled in Grenoble and embarked on the adventure of mountain guiding.
I pursue this activity alongside a salaried job as an engineer in the construction industry, specializing in energy renovation. These two activities are deeply complementary for me: as an engineer, I want to contribute to a more environmentally respectful future. The mountains, by constantly amazing me, remind me why I dedicate my energy every day to preserving the natural environments in which we live.
I feel this wonder at all scales: from the flower I observe with a magnifying glass to the immensity of the landscapes and the unleashing of the elements, including unexpected encounters with animals or the special atmosphere of a misty forest. If I take people to the mountains, it’s to share and pass on this love and curiosity for what surrounds us!
As a mountain guide in training (soon to be qualified, all being well! I have had the prerogatives to lead groups since 2023), I accompany you safely on day trips or half-day trips (including themed outings), or on multi-day treks around Grenoble or elsewhere in the Alps.
I am trained in non-violent communication: benevolence, listening, and attention are part of my values. Limiting my impact when going to the mountains is also close to my heart: whenever possible, I offer trips accessible by public transport; when this is not possible, we maximize carpooling.
Looking forward to seeing you on the trails!

Whether you’re just passing through Isère or a year-round Grenoble resident, come discover or rediscover Chartreuse, Vercors, and Belledonne. I guide you on the trails, sharing my passion for the mountain environment.
Here are some example hikes I can accompany you on. Many other routes are possible, and I adapt the project according to your desires and requests. Don’t hesitate to contact me to choose a date and destination together!
Vercors #Les Balcons du Vercors #A hike at the foot of the majestic cliffs of Vercors, offering a panoramic view of the Ecrins.
Duration: one day Difficulty: moderate to difficult (evolving in rocky terrain) Audience: adults and children from 12 years old - maximum 12 people Location: departure from Col de l’Arzelier Dates: on request Rate for a constituted group: €250 Rocher du Baconnet #Little frequented, the Rocher du Baconnet offers an unparalleled view of Trièves, the cliffs of Vercors, and the mythical Mont Aiguille.
Duration: one day Difficulty: easy to moderate Audience: adults and children from 12 years old - maximum 12 people Location: departure from Gresse-en-Vercors Dates: on request Rate for a constituted group: €250 Chartreuse #Tour du Vallon d’Hurtières #A very beautiful beech forest opens and closes this route, which takes you through the open landscapes of the Hurtières valley, at the foot of the limestone cliff of the Grande Sure. Clear weather will even allow you to enjoy a view of Mont Blanc.
Duration: one day Difficulty: moderate Audience: adults and children from 12 years old - maximum 12 people Location: departure from Col de la Charmette Dates: on request Rate for a constituted group: €250 Belledonne #Le Grand Van from Chamrousse #Chamrousse is a privileged gateway to Belledonne: the ski resort quickly gives way to preserved atmospheres. This loop takes you to the must-see Lacs Roberts, then allows you to reach the summit of Grand Van via wild and unmarked paths.
Duration: one day Difficulty: difficult (evolving in rocky terrain on unmarked paths) Audience: adults and teens from 14 years old - maximum 12 people Location: departure from Chamrousse Dates: on request Rate for a constituted group: €250 Tour du Grand Replomb #The Tour du Grand Replomb offers a great variety of landscapes, typical of the Belledonne massif: high-altitude forest, mineral atmosphere characteristic of the Col de la Mine de Fer, and a glacial lake with a commanding view of Lac de Crop.
Duration: one day Difficulty: difficult (evolving in rocky terrain, significant elevation gain) Audience: adults and teens from 14 years old - maximum 12 people Location: departure from Pré Marcel Dates: on request Rate for a constituted group: €250
title: Day Hikes

content:
Botanical Hikes #Curious Plants #Take a walk and open your eyes to the plants along the path: many of them hold surprises, whether they are edible, medicinal, or deadly poisonous. During this outing, I will share anecdotes about the plants we encounter. Enough to awaken your curiosity!
Duration: half-day Difficulty: very easy Audience: adults and children from 12 years old, maximum 10 people Dates: on request, from April to August Location: around Grenoble, depending on the season (vegetation progress) and your preferences Rate for a constituted group: €150 Contact me to choose a date and destination together!
Budding Botanist #What exactly is a flower? How does it work? How to recognize plants for sure? During a mountain hike, we will learn to observe and describe a plant, then discover the basics of identifying plant families using a determination key. We will alternate between discussion times, practical workshops, and walking.
The goal of this outing is twofold: to give you basic methods for recognizing plant species, but above all, to invite you to observe the detail and the incredible diversity of the plant world.
Duration: one day Difficulty: easy Audience: adults, maximum 10 people Location: around Grenoble, depending on the season (vegetation progress) and your preferences Dates: on request, from April to August Rate for a constituted group: €250 Contact me to choose a date and destination together!
Ornithology #Listening to Birds #It’s spring, the birds are singing… But have you ever wondered who these virtuosic singers are? For the duration of a mountain hike, let’s open our ears wide to be charmed by the birdsong and learn to recognize the main species. It is often easier to hear the birds than to see them!
Duration: one day Difficulty: easy Audience: adults, maximum 10 people Location: according to your preferences and the season, around Grenoble Dates: on request, from April to August Rate for a constituted group: €250 Contact me to choose a date and destination together!
title: Themed Outings

content:
Multi-day trekking is an exceptional experience! Sleeping in the mountains means completely disconnecting from your daily routine and refocusing on your needs, sensations, and the pleasures of the moment. By walking for several days, it is also possible to access more remote places: trekking then becomes a micro-adventure and an immersion in the wildest environments. Mountain huts allow you to find a comfortable and cozy space in a convivial atmosphere.
I offer multi-day stays with overnight stays in huts around Grenoble. These stays are adaptable according to your desires and requests. Contact me to choose a date and destination together!
Upcoming stays… #
title: Multi-day Trekking

content:
I accompany you in your hiking projects, whether for a day or a multi-day trek, whether they are at the idea stage or already defined. I ensure the custom planning of your hike and guidance on the field. Around Grenoble (Chartreuse, Vercors, Belledonne, Taillefer…), I operate for day trips, and for multi-day treks, I am happy to travel to the rest of the Alps.
Contact me to build a project together! A personalized quote will be sent to you after defining your needs together.
